```{r load_libraries, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  # Third-party packages (alphabetical order within group)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  # Add other third-party packages here. Only load what the report uses.
})
```

```{r helper_functions, include=FALSE}
#' Read the input table
#'
#' @param path Path to a CSV file
#' @return A data frame with the identifier column read as text
read_input_table <- function(path) {
  read.csv(path, colClasses = c(sample = "character"), check.names = FALSE)
}

#' Plot the reads of each sample
#'
#' @param data A data frame with the columns `sample` and `reads`
#' @return A ggplot object
plot_reads <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = sample, y = reads)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
input_data <- tryCatch(
  read_input_table(params$input_file),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
```

```{r report_header, results='asis'}
# Show the logo and apply the style sheet only when the params give them.
if (!is.null(params$css)) {
  cat(as.character(htmltools::includeCSS(params$css)), "\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$logo)) {
  cat(as.character(htmltools::img(src = knitr::image_uri(params$logo), alt = "Logo", style = "height: 60px;")), "\n\n")
}
if (!is.null(params$report_author)) {
  cat("Prepared by", params$report_author, "\n\n")
}
```

<!-- Summary -->

```{r summary, eval=params$show_summary && !is.null(input_data), results='asis'}
cat("# Summary\n\n")
cat("The input table has", nrow(input_data), "rows.\n\n")
print(kable(head(input_data)))
```

```{r summary_plot, eval=params$show_summary && !is.null(input_data), fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
tryCatch({
  print(plot_reads(input_data))
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error generating the reads plot:", e$message, "\n")
})
```

```{r no_data, eval=is.null(input_data), results='asis'}
cat("The input table could not be read, so the data sections are left out.\n\n")
```
